title: Find the Width of Columns of a Grid
summary: Given a 0-indexed m x n integer matrix grid, determine the width of each column by finding the maximum length of integers in that column.
statement: Given a 0-indexed m x n integer matrix grid, determine the width of each column by finding the maximum length of integers in that column. For each column i, the width is the length of the longest integer, where the length of a non-negative integer x with len digits is len, and the length of a negative integer is len + 1. Return an array ans of size n, where ans[i] represents the width of the i^th column.
constraints: grid is a nonempty rectangular integer matrix.
A column width is the greatest printed character length in that column; a minus sign counts.
Return widths from leftmost column to rightmost.
hints: Convert each integer to its ordinary string representation.
Maintain one maximum character length per column.
Visit every matrix cell and update only its column maximum.
Every candidate printed width is examined exactly once, and string conversion naturally includes a negative sign.
editorial: Every candidate printed width is examined exactly once, and string conversion naturally includes a negative sign.

tests.explanation: The printed lengths one, two, and three make the sole column width three.
The first column needs three characters for -15 and the second needs four for 2000.
